props.headline: Let AI Handle the Busywork.
props.text: You started your business to do what you love, not to drown in admin, missed leads, and repetitive tasks. We build simple, reliable AI automations that work quietly in the background, so you can focus on growing your business.

items.title: Automate the Busywork
items.text: We connect your existing tools (like email, CRM, and calendar) to work together automatically. From instant lead follow-ups to automated invoicing, we eliminate the manual tasks that slow you down. Perfect for Real Estate, Trades, and Professional Services.

items.title: Websites That Work While You Sleep
items.text: A slow or broken website costs you customers. We build and maintain fast, secure, and mobile-friendly websites that capture leads effortlessly, complete with automated booking and contact forms. Perfect for Healthcare, Retail, and Hospitality.

items.title: Never Lose Institutional Knowledge
items.text: When a team member leaves, their knowledge shouldn't leave with them. We set up smart, self-updating documentation systems that train new staff faster and keep your operations running smoothly, no matter who is on shift.
